blocker.reason: The accessible extended balanced macro panel omits these calendar months. Frozen Stage-2 rules require no-release indicators to remain missing within an otherwise retained monthly row; dropping the months or setting all eight macro features to zero would alter the frozen information set/scoring dates.
blocker.required_source: deterministic_data2 - Oct26.xlsx or equivalent frozen first-print/Bloomberg-consensus macro source containing the exact 2025-10, 2025-11, and 2025-12 feature rows.

risk_free_operationalization.series: FRED DTB4WK — 4-Week Treasury Bill Secondary Market Rate, Discount Basis
risk_free_operationalization.conversion: At period start, convert the DTB4WK bank-discount quote to the implied 28-day bill effective return; accrue that rate over the exact calendar holding days. For 12M momentum, roll the same rule across month-end subperiods.

implementation_bug_note: A negative-month arithmetic bug in the month helper initially rendered January minus two months incorrectly. The 48-label assertion caught it before performance metrics were exposed. The helper was corrected and all seven systems were rerun from scratch; no frozen parameter changed.
